question: Should assistant-message copy in the Control UI become a per-click Markdown/plain-text menu, a persisted default-format preference, or stay Markdown-only for now?
rationale: This request adds UX surface and plain-text conversion semantics rather than fixing a broken documented contract, so automation should not choose the product shape without maintainer direction.

options.title: Add Per-Click Format Menu
options.body: Add a small copy menu with Markdown and Plain Text actions so existing behavior stays available without adding persisted configuration.

options.title: Add Default Format Preference
options.body: Add a user preference for default copy format, accepting the extra preference surface and upgrade/test burden.

options.title: Keep Markdown-Only
options.body: Close or defer the request if maintainers do not want more copy-format UI in the Control UI chat surface.

recommendation.title: Add Per-Click Format Menu
recommendation.body: Add a small copy menu with Markdown and Plain Text actions so existing behavior stays available without adding persisted configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and already participated in the issue review, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the UX decision.
